thread:
laura (partnerships): ok folks — we need a concrete plan for SI onboarding and enablement. cloud marketplace listings, playbooks, training, and a lightweight cert. who can own what?
aj: I can lead the training curriculum. thinking a 2-day bootcamp + follow-up labs. slides + hands-on. will draft agenda today. :muscle:
mike_r: +1 on the bootcamp. we need an infra checklist for Private deployments (VPC, KMS, on-prem packaging). otherwise SIs will hit roadblocks during PoCs.
nina_sales: also need a deal registration + co-sell playbook. SIs ask about margins, partner portal, and joint GTM materials. can we standardize a 1-pager bundle?
tara_eng: I can own the repo with example infra templates and an automated env provisioning script. will add Terraform + K8s manifests and a readme for hardware requirements.
karthik_hw: from hardware partner side — we should include GPU compatibility matrix and a short cert badge for partners who validated models on each vendor (A100, H100, ML-specific ASICs). we can provide test vectors.
laura (partnerships): perfect. aj — share the draft bootcamp agenda in the thread. mike/r — can you draft the infra checklist as a single doc we can link in the playbook? nina — I'll work with you on the 1-pager bundle.
aj: draft agenda below. feedback welcome.
```
Day 1 (4h): intro + architecture, hosted vs dedicated vs private, deployment patterns, security/KMS
Lab 1 (2h): deploy a sample model on Dedicated, observe metrics in Console
Day 2 (4h): troubleshooting, observability, batching/caching, cost tuning
Lab 2 (2h): configure autoscaling + run perf tests, joint-runbook walkthrough
Certification: pass a practical lab + short multiple choice (70% pass)
```

mike_r: infra checklist highlights: networking (VPCs, subnets), KMS/HSM keys, firewall rules, certs, storage perf, GPU drivers + CUDA versions, supported OS images. I'll throw a checklist in Google Drive and add link here by EOD.

nina_sales: for the 1-pager bundle — include: partner benefits, co-sell process, sample pricing bands, support SLAs, lead handoff flow, and marketing assets. Can we get a sample customer case study? even small. :pray:

tara_eng: onboarding automation note — need an ephemeral tenant script for labs so SIs can run without messing prod. I'll add `provision_lab.sh` and a cleanup hook. also add a `known_issues.md` for common failures.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: draft materials due in 48 hours (autogenerated). :spiral_calendar:
karthik_hw: test vectors — I'll attach a small suite (latency/throughput, perf under batching) and a one-page doc on quantization caveats per vendor.
laura (partnerships): timeline proposal: drafts collected by Fri (1741629999), internal review next Mon, pilot bootcamp week after. ok?
aj: works for me.
mike_r: Fri is tight but doable. I'll prioritize the checklist.
nina_sales: fine. I'll pull the marketing PM for the case study brief.
tara_eng: will open the repo today: `github.com/redwood-inference/si-onboard` (private) and push initial scaffolding.
laura (partnerships): volunteers to review final playbook: aj, mike_r, nina_sales, tara_eng, karthik_hw — thanks. I'll consolidate links and create a shared checklist doc. also we should schedule a short sync with legal for partner MSA templates — anyone to join?
mike_r: I'll join.
laura (partnerships): great. final ask: for the certification, keep it lightweight — badge + one practical lab. we want low friction. aj — add pass criteria and renewal cadence in the draft.
aj: will add cert rubric (practical scoring + 20-question quiz). renewal = yearly or after major platform changes.
laura (partnerships): perfect. I'll follow up with calendar invites and a single GH issue to track tasks. thanks all :raised_hands:"
